title: Scuba Diver Displacement
body: A scuba diver makes a slow descent into the ocean. His vertical position with respect to a boat on the surface changes as follows: descends $$9.0\, \text{m}, $$ ascends $$3.0\, \text{m}, $$ descends $$12.0\, \text{m}, $$ ascends $$4.0\, \text{m}, $$ descends $$18.0\, \text{m}, $$ ascends $$7.0\, \text{m}, $$ and descends $$24.0\, \text{m}.$$ Assuming the positive $$\hat{j}\text{-direction}$$ is up toward the surface, express his net vertical displacement vector in terms of the unit vector $$\hat{j}.$$ What is his distance to the boat?
